verdict.rationale: Customization is a fair axis for a CRM, but the evidence pack has no documentation of adding custom fields or building filtered, sorted, or shared list views. The only related material is general community commentary that Salesforce is strong at 'customizations', and another comment says companies need consultants. Neither documents an ops user doing this without an admin project.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can add custom fields and build filtered, sorted, and shared views without an admin project
